description: Returns one company's current snapshot: price with its market session, performance, 52-week range, trend, fundamentals from its SEC filings, balance sheet (cash, debt as filed, financings since, runway, share count), risk (beta, volatility), FINRA short interest, and its SEC profile with its own description — every figure with the date it holds for. Use it when the user asks about one company's price, market cap, valuation, fundamentals or risk. A pre-IPO company (e.g. 'anthropic') returns what its prospectus and the funds file instead: no price, the last round's price per common share and the implied value on both share counts.

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_company
title: Company snapshot
